Package com.coachservice.app.service

Class CoachService

java.lang.Object
com.coachservice.app.service.CoachService
@Service public class CoachService extends Object
Service class for managing Coach entities and generating coach-related data.

Provides operations for finding, creating, and updating Coach entities. Includes functionality to generate a showcase of coaches based on user preferences and specializations.

Key methods:

  • findById(Long): Retrieves a Coach by its ID. Throws CoachNotFoundException if the coach does not exist.
  • create(Coach): Saves a new Coach entity to the repository.
  • update(Coach): Updates an existing Coach entity in the repository.
  • createShowcase(Long): Generates a showcase of coaches categorized by specialization, based on the provided user ID.
  • createCoach(CoachInfoTransferDto): Creates a new Coach from a CoachInfoTransferDto object.

Dependencies:

  • ICoachRepository: Repository interface for performing CRUD operations on Coach entities.
  • WebClient: Used for making HTTP requests to external services (e.g., fetching user information).
  • PillarService: Service for managing Pillar entities, used for retrieving pillar details.
  • CoachMapper: Mapper for converting between Coach entities and DTOs.

Configuration Properties:

  • user.service.name: The hostname or IP address of the user service.
  • user.service.port: The port on which the user service is running.
  • image.service.name: The hostname or IP address of the image service.
  • image.service.port: The port on which the image service is running.
